page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7a-nps1.16xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance based on the KVM hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated vCPUs powered by an AMD EPYC 7T83 processor running at a base clock speed of 2.55 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The instance is equipped with 128.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.

This server configuration does not include any bundled local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through external network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 16 Gbps, and the instance does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and 1:2 CPU-to-RAM ratio provide a dense compute profile, though the lack of local storage and public IPv4 addresses requires factoring in external storage and networking overheads.

Given its high core count and compute-centric memory ratio, the ecs.c7a-nps1.16xlarge is designed for compute-heavy workloads. Suitable applications include high-performance web serving, batch processing, distributed analytics, and scientific modeling where raw CPU performance is prioritized over large memory footprints or local storage IOPS.
